license_required.quote: before a person acts as an insurance producer in the State, the person must obtain: (1) a license in the kind or subdivision of insurance for which the person intends to act as an insurance producer

issuing_authority.quote: the Commissioner shall issue a license in a kind or subdivision of insurance or a combination of kinds or subdivisions of insurance to each applicant who meets the requirements of this subtitle

name.quote: the Commissioner shall issue a license in a kind or subdivision of insurance or a combination of kinds or subdivisions of insurance to each applicant who meets the requirements of this subtitle

type.quote: the Commissioner shall issue a license in a kind or subdivision of insurance or a combination of kinds or subdivisions of insurance to each applicant who meets the requirements of this subtitle

age_minimum.quote: An applicant must be at least 18 years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant must be of good character and trustworthy based on the standards of § 10–126 of this subtitle.

required.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section, the applicant must pass an examination given by the Commissioner under this subtitle.

experience_source.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section, the applicant must pass an examination given by the Commissioner under this subtitle.

exams.name: Written examination (property/casualty/other lines)
exams.notes: Applicant must pass a written examination relating to the kind or subdivision of insurance for which the applicant wants to become licensed. Applicant who fails may not retake for at least 4 days.
exams.quote: the applicant shall pass a written examination that relates to that kind or subdivision of insurance

exams.name: Written examination (life/health/annuities)
exams.notes: Each individual applicant must pass a personal written examination. Applicant who fails may not retake for at least 4 days. Certain applicants (credit life/health, legacy HMO/dental/nonprofit plan producers) are exempt.
exams.quote: Each individual applicant must pass a personal written examination to determine: (i) the competence of the applicant as to life insurance, health insurance, or annuities

interval_years.quote: Licenses expire every other year on the date stated on the license unless renewed as provided in this section.

required.quote: the Commissioner shall require an insurance producer to receive continuing education as a condition of renewing the license of the insurance producer.

hours_per_period.quote: The Commissioner may not require an individual who holds a license to receive more than 24 hours of continuing education per renewal period.

period_years.quote: Licenses expire every other year on the date stated on the license unless renewed as provided in this section.

value: at least 3 hours relating directly to ethics
long-term care insurance (if selling long-term care)
bail bond insurance (if selling bail bonds)
Senior Prescription Drug Assistance Program (if marketing that program)
topical_requirements.quote: Of the required hours of continuing education per renewal period required under subparagraphs (i), (ii), (iii), and (iv) of this paragraph, at least 3 hours shall relate directly to ethics.

available.quote: the Commissioner shall waive any license application requirements for an applicant who is not a resident of this State if: (1) the applicant has a valid license from the home state of the applicant; and (2) the home state of the applicant awards nonresident licenses to residents of this State on the same basis.

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must have a valid resident license in good standing in their home state, submit the home-state application or a completed uniform application, pay the applicable fee, and the home state must award nonresident licenses to Maryland residents on the same basis. Exam requirements are waived for qualifying nonresidents.
requirements.quote: a person that is not a resident of this State may obtain a nonresident license to act as an insurance producer if: (i) the person currently is licensed as a resident insurance producer and in good standing in the person's home state

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has obtained or attempted to obtain a license by misrepresentation, concealment, or other fraud

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted by final judgment in any state or federal court of a felony or crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has knowingly participated in writing or issuing substantial over–insurance of property insurance risks

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has failed an examination required by this subtitle

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has willfully failed to comply with or has willfully violated a proper order, subpoena, or regulation of the Commissioner or the insurance regulatory authority of another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed or refused to pay over on demand money belonging to an insurer, producer, or other entitled person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has failed or refused to pay over on demand money that belongs to an insurer, insurance producer, or other person entitled to the money

disciplinary_grounds.description: Otherwise shown a lack of trustworthiness or competence to act as an insurance producer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has otherwise shown a lack of trustworthiness or competence to act as an insurance producer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is not or does not intend to carry on business in good faith as an insurance producer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is not or does not intend to carry on business in good faith and represent to the public that the person is an insurance producer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Has been denied a license or certificate in another state or had a license or certificate suspended or revoked in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been denied a license or certificate in another state or has had a license or certificate suspended or revoked in another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or willfully made statements materially misrepresenting policy terms to induce surrender or lapse for replacement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has intentionally or willfully made or issued, or caused to be made or issued, a statement that materially misrepresents or makes incomplete comparisons about the terms or conditions of a policy or contract issued by an authorized insurer, for the purpose of inducing or attempting to induce the owner of the policy or contract to forfeit or surrender it or allow it to lapse in order to replace it with another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transacted insurance business directed by a person whose license was suspended or revoked, knowing of the suspension or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has transacted insurance business that was directed to the applicant or holder for consideration by a person whose license or certificate to engage in the insurance business at the time was suspended or revoked, and the applicant or holder knew or should have known of the suspension or revocation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicited, procured, or negotiated insurance contracts for an unauthorized insurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has solicited, procured, or negotiated insurance contracts for an unauthorized insurer, including contracts for nonprofit health service plans, dental plan organizations, and health maintenance organizations

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has knowingly employed or knowingly continued to employ an individual acting in a fiduciary capacity who has been convicted of a felony or crime of moral turpitude within the preceding 10 years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forged another's name to an application for insurance or any document related to an insurance transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has forged another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly used notes or other reference material to complete a licensing examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has improperly used notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay income tax or related interest or penalty under a final assessment or tax court order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has failed to pay income tax or related interest or penalty under: (i) an assessment under the Tax – General Article that is final and no longer subject to review by the tax court; or (ii) an order of the tax court that is final and no longer subject to judicial review

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made an inaccurate statement with actual malice in providing termination information under § 10-118
disciplinary_grounds.quote: in providing information under § 10–118 of this subtitle regarding the termination of an appointment with an insurer, has made an inaccurate statement with actual malice

bonding_required.quote: a business entity applicant for a license as a title insurance producer shall file with the Commissioner: (i) a blanket fidelity bond covering appropriate employees and title insurance producer independent contractors; and (ii) 1. a blanket surety bond; or 2. a letter of credit.

definition_quote.value: A license authorizes the holder of the license to act as an insurance producer for the kind or subdivision of insurance or combination of kinds or subdivisions of insurance specified in the license.
definition_quote.quote: A license authorizes the holder of the license to act as an insurance producer for the kind or subdivision of insurance or combination of kinds or subdivisions of insurance specified in the license.

methods_authorized.quote: before a person acts as an insurance producer in the State, the person must obtain: (1) a license in the kind or subdivision of insurance for which the person intends to act as an insurance producer

value: accident and health or sickness insurance
variable life and variable annuity products
personal lines of property and casualty insurance
lines_of_authority.quote: An applicant may qualify for a license in one or more of the following kinds of insurance: (i) life insurance; (ii) accident and health or sickness insurance; (iii) property insurance; (iv) casualty insurance; (v) variable life and variable annuity products; (vi) personal lines of property and casualty insurance; (vii) limited line credit insurance

resident_license_available.quote: A person who applies for a license as a resident insurance producer shall: (1) in the case of an applicant who is an individual, submit to the Commissioner a uniform application

nonresident_license_available.quote: a person that is not a resident of this State may obtain a nonresident license to act as an insurance producer

business_entity_license_available.quote: Before a business entity may accept in its own name compensation for acting as an insurance producer in the State, the business entity must obtain: (1) a license in the kind or subdivision of insurance for which the business entity intends to act as an insurance producer

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: To qualify for a license as an insurance producer, a business entity must designate a licensed insurance producer to act as the business entity's principal contact with the Administration.

temporary_license_available.quote: Without regard to the examination requirements of this subtitle, the Commissioner may issue a temporary license to act as an insurance producer to an individual

temporary_license_max_days.quote: A temporary license issued under subsection (a) of this section expires 15 months after its effective date.

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: an insurance producer may not act on behalf of an insurer unless the insurance producer has received written documentation of the appointment from the insurer.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: When there is any termination of the appointment, employment, contract, or other insurance business relationship with an insurance producer, the insurer shall, within 30 days following the effective date of the termination, update the insurer's producer register by entering the effective date of the termination.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: Within 30 days after the final disposition of the matter, an insurance producer shall report to the Commissioner any adverse administrative action taken against the insurance producer: (i) in another jurisdiction; or (ii) by another governmental unit in this State.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The Commissioner may verify the licensing status of a nonresident insurance producer through the producer database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners, its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this State shall apply to become licensed as a resident insurance producer under § 10–111 of this subtitle within 90 days after establishing legal residence in this State.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: For up to 1 year after the expiration date, a person whose license has expired may reinstate the expired license

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: The designated responsible person described in subsubparagraph 1 of this subparagraph or the president, secretary, treasurer, and any other officer or person of the limited lines travel insurance producer who directs or controls the operations of the limited lines travel insurance producer shall comply with fingerprinting requirements applicable to insurance producers in the State.
